headerDisplay: Enter your Mitsubishi **Wi-Fi Control** app credentials to discover your units.

password.title: User Password
password.description: Password used on your Mitsubishi Wi-Fi Control app

dry.title: Expose Dry Mode
dry.description: Show a Dry Mode switch in HomeKit when the unit supports drying. Restart the Mitsubishi bridge after changing this setting.

fan.title: Expose Fan Mode
fan.description: Show a Fan Mode switch in HomeKit. Restart the Mitsubishi bridge after changing this setting.
